inputs.share_count_basis: 691,792,268 shares in issue at 30 June 2026 (interim report p.1107) plus 5,267,309 dilutive options/RSUs from the H1 FY2026 diluted-EPS table (interim note 11) = 697.06m fully diluted. Held FLAT: SBC is fully expensed in the flows, so grant dilution is charged once. The 490,000 Yikuai earn-out consideration shares issued 23 March 2026 are already inside the 30 June count. H1 FY2026 repurchases of RMB128.8m were cancelled (count fell from 694.9m at Dec-2025).
inputs.cash_composition: RMB m at 30 June 2026: bank balances 807.068 + time deposits 891.154 (495.000 non-current + 396.154 current) + current FVTPL financial assets 554.211 (wealth-management products/notes/funds, redeemable at any time, Level 2) + long-term principal-protected notes at amortised cost 375.397 = 2,627.83. Bank borrowings 130.366 (discounted-notes advances). EXCLUDED: restricted bank deposits 1,241.481 (pledged for issuance of bank-acceptance notes payable; note 23 FY2025 AR) and the matching notes payable 2,145.576 inside trade and other payables, both left in working capital; lease liabilities 165.731 (treatment B); non-current FVTPL 6.0 and amounts due from an associate 48.7 (immaterial, conservative); NCI is a deficit (-52.5) and is not credited.
inputs.interest_income_note: Bank interest income 46.927 + investment income from FVTPL financial assets 15.946 (FY2025 AR note 6), both stripped because their source assets (time deposits, wealth-management products, notes) are in the net-cash bridge. Net cash is ~6x the owner-FCF base, far above the 1x threshold.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 AR consolidated cash flow statement line 3674 'Share-based payment expense 64,128' (RMB thousands); no equity-award cash taxes disclosed (net-share settlement not used; EquityAwardTaxes = 0 in kpis). H1 FY2026 SBC was 15.692.
inputs.buyback_note: FY2025 financing outflow 'Repurchase of shares' RMB65.8m; H1 FY2026 RMB128.8m (shares cancelled). The company is a repurchaser, so the flat count is funded, not a convention.
inputs.fx_note: CNY/HKD 1.1754 (1 CNY = 1.1754 HKD), Yahoo Finance CNYHKD=X, 2026-10-23. Model values are computed in CNY and multiplied by fx_rate to the HKD quote. No dual listing exists for a parity check; cross-check: USDHKD ~7.78 / USDCNY ~6.62 = 1.175, consistent. Statements are in RMB thousands (interim and annual reports); the HKEX quote is HKD.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in CNY, the currency of the flows. BASE WACC 10.0%: China 10-year CGB ~1.8% risk-free, equity risk premium ~6.5% (mature-market 4.5% plus ~2% China country risk), beta ~1.1 for a HKEX-listed China platform gives a cost of equity ~9%, plus ~1% small-cap premium = 10%. Debt is immaterial (RMB130m discounted-notes advances against RMB2.6bn of cash), so WACC = cost of equity. STRUCTURAL PREMIUMS added 2026-10-24 after the multiples sanity check tripped (implied P/B 3.13x and EV/EBITDA 46.5x at the weighted IV vs 10yr maxima of 2.02x and 26.2x; diagnosis wacc_too_low): (1) small-cap illiquidity +1.5%: HKD ~2.5bn market cap, ~70% share-price fall since the IPO lock-up expiry, thin HKEX turnover and a 52-week range of 2.96-10.45 - the 1% already inside the base rate was too small for a stock that has re-rated 3x in a year; (2) regulatory single-point-of-failure +1.0%: every revenue line depends on PRC drug-distribution (GSP) and online drug-sale licences held through a VIE structure, HNTE 15% tax status renewed every three years, and the supply-chain-finance line sits under PRC lending rules; (3) concentrated geography +0.5%: 100% of revenue is PRC outside-of-hospital pharmacies and clinics, exposed to one policy regime (VBP, Healthy China 2030, medical-insurance reform) with no diversification. The sanity-check keyword was customer concentration; that premium is NOT charged - YSB has ~460k active buyers and no customer above 1% of revenue - and no cyclicality premium is charged because pharma distribution is defensive; the competitive/thin-margin risk (SOE distributors, JD/Ali Health, marketplace shrinkage) stays in the bear flows and the 30% bear weight rather than being stacked into the rate as well. TOTAL WACC 13.0%, used in all three scenarios so that the scenarios differ in operating outcome, not in discount rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: (B) Leases as operating cost. The full IFRS-16 lease cash (FY2025: principal 81.378 + interest 8.976 = 90.354, 0.43% of revenue; H1 FY2026 44.398, 0.43%) is charged inside EBIT via lease_cost_pct_path, and lease liabilities (165.731 at 30 June 2026) are EXCLUDED from net debt. ebitda_margin_path is the post-IFRS-16 adjusted EBITDA (pre-SBC, pre-lease, ex interest/investment income and ex FVTPL fair-value gains); da_pct_path is D&A EX right-of-use depreciation (FY2025: PPE 28.019 + intangibles 44.385 = 72.404, 0.35%), so the lease is charged exactly once.
inputs.nci_treatment: Non-controlling interests are a deficit of RMB52.5m (loss-making minority-held subsidiaries); NCI share of profit was -7.0m FY2025 and -2.0m H1 FY2026. Flows are modelled at the consolidated level and nothing is deducted or credited for NCI, which is marginally conservative (an NCI deficit would add value if charged).
inputs.working_capital_note: YSB runs a negative cash conversion cycle (~-35 to -39 days): payables 4,642 vs inventories 1,912 + receivables 598 at 30 June 2026, a supplier float of ~RMB2.1bn (~10% of revenue). Working capital is modelled on the CHANGE in revenue: FY2025 captured 11.4% (+348.7m on +3,066m revenue), FY2024 ~50% (inventory release). Base 8%, bull 10%, bear 10% (symmetric: in the bear's revenue-decline years the float unwinds and cash flows OUT at the structural ratio). Because ~RMB2.1bn of the RMB2.5bn net cash is this float, the cash is only fully shareholders' on a going-concern basis; that is the reason the market can price the equity below net cash, and it is the first thing to re-check if revenue turns down.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF component DCF (operating company: B2B pharmaceutical distribution/marketplace, routed via dcf-methods SKILL.md row 2 'operating company, non-US' with the adaptations file for currency, leases, NCI and the matching-asset rule). Not a bank or REIT; the supply-chain finance line is funded by third-party institutions and is immaterial to the flows. FY0 = FY2025 (year to 31 December 2025); year 1 = FY2026. Adjusted EBITDA FY2025 = PBT 137.045 + finance costs 11.927 + associate loss 5.960 - bank interest 46.927 - FVTPL investment income 15.946 - FVTPL fair-value gains 23.149 + contingent-consideration FV loss 2.112 - subsidiary disposal gain 2.422 = 68.6 operating EBIT, + D&A 152.720 + SBC 64.128 = 285.4 (1.36% margin); H1 FY2026 on the same basis ~175 (1.70%), H2 FY2025 ~1.17%. last_fcf = reported FCF 619.464 - SBC 64.128 - interest/investment income 62.873 - lease cash 90.354 = 402.11 (owner FCF, treatment B); it includes the FY2025 working-capital inflow of 348.7m, so ex-float owner FCF was only ~53m - the component build (not the FY2025 FCF margin) is carried forward. Cash tax: no current tax has been paid in any year (unrecognised tax losses RMB1,310m at Dec-2025, of which 261m expires 2026, 364m 2027, 234m 2028; HNTE 15% rate on the technology subsidiaries, 25% on distribution subsidiaries, 200% R&D super-deduction), so cash tax ramps 0% -> 20% over six years rather than being perpetuated. Capex is tiny (PPE + intangibles 18.2m FY2025, 0.09%; H1 FY2026 22.5m) but bolt-on acquisitions run ~31-36m/yr, so capex_pct is set at 0.20% to cover both. SENSITIVITY TO THE CASH DEFINITION: if the RMB904m of bank-acceptance notes payable NOT covered by pledged deposits (2,145.6 - 1,241.5) were treated as bank debt, net cash would fall to ~RMB1.59bn, about RMB1.30 (HKD 1.52) per share off every scenario. Price is the HKEX regular close of 2026-10-23, not an after-hours print.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: H1 FY2026 revenue growth (+4.5% YoY: Self-operation +5.3%, Online Marketplace -13.3%), used as the FY2026 run-rate. Equity CAGR is not usable as the primary source: equity was negative in FY2022 (pre-IPO preferred shares at fair value) and the FY2023 base is distorted by the IPO; EPS was negative before FY2024.
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Historical revenue CAGR (13.7% 3yr, 11.2% 2yr) is far above the selected 4.5%: FY2025's +17.1% included the Yikuai acquisition, and growth has since decelerated sharply (active buyers +18% FY2024 -> +6.5% FY2025 -> flat H1 FY2026). The high-margin Online Marketplace is shrinking. The forward path is anchored to the run-rate, not the history.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF series (reported FCF - SBC - bank interest - FVTPL investment income - lease cash): FY2022 ~-102, FY2023 ~176, FY2024 ~330, FY2025 ~402 (RMB m). The owner-FCF 2yr CAGR (51%) exceeds the reported-FCF CAGR (19.5%) because SBC fell from 118m to 64m while reported FCF grew - the opposite of the usual warning - but every year of the series is dominated by the supplier-float inflow (FY2024 +467m, FY2025 +349m), so neither CAGR is a growth signal.

base.exit_multiple_cap_note: exit_multiple_cap 26.2x EV/EBITDA (10yr average on the sanity-check basis; single data point FY2025). Non-binding: the implied terminal EV/EBITDA at 13% WACC is 5.9x and Gordon binds; terminal_cap_multiple 14x owner FCF (~23x EBITDA at the year-10 FCF/EBITDA ratio of 0.60) is the tighter FCF-side cap and is also non-binding.
base.rationale: Growth: FY2026 at the H1 run-rate (+4.5%), a modest lift to 5% in FY2027-28 as private-label/Targeted Product Launch (+18.6% H1 FY2026) and bolt-ons offset a shrinking marketplace, then decay to 2.5%. Margin: adjusted EBITDA from 1.5% (between H1 FY2026's 1.70% and H2 FY2025's 1.17%) to 2.2% by year 8 as own-brand mix lifts Self-operation gross margin (6.2% FY2024 -> 7.7% FY2025 -> 8.0% H1 FY2026) - roughly +0.1pp/yr, slower than FY2025's +0.6pp. SBC 0.25% easing to 0.20% (FY2025 0.31%, H1 FY2026 0.15%). Cash tax 0% for two years on the unrecognised losses, ramping to a 20% blended rate (15% HNTE / 25% EIT). Terminal cap 14x owner FCF for a thin-margin distributor.

bull.exit_multiple_cap_note: exit_multiple_cap 26.2x EV/EBITDA (10yr maximum on the sanity-check basis; single data point FY2025). Non-binding: implied terminal EV/EBITDA 7.1x, Gordon binds; terminal_cap_multiple 15x owner FCF stays as the FCF-side cap.
bull.rationale: Pharmaceutical retail downturn ends in 2027, buyer growth resumes mid-single digits, private label keeps compounding at 30%+ and lifts the adjusted EBITDA margin to 3% (Self-operation gross margin ~10%), on-demand retail and SaaS add a second leg, and bolt-on M&A continues. Working capital captured at the full structural float ratio (10%).

bear.exit_multiple_cap_note: exit_multiple_cap 26.2x EV/EBITDA (10yr minimum on the sanity-check basis; single data point FY2025). Non-binding: implied terminal EV/EBITDA 2.4x, Gordon binds; terminal_cap_multiple 12x owner FCF stays as the FCF-side cap.
bear.rationale: The buyer base has saturated: revenue flattens in FY2027 and falls 3%/2% in FY2028-29 as SOE distributors (Jointown, Shanghai Pharma) and JD/Ali Health B2B channels take share and the marketplace keeps shrinking; private-label gains are competed away, adjusted EBITDA margin compresses to 1.1%. The supplier float unwinds at 10% of the revenue decline, turning owner FCF close to zero in FY2028-29. Terminal cap 12x; the equity is then mostly the remaining cash.

exit_multiple_cap.basis: EV / (EBITDA less SBC), the sanity-check basis. Historical range is a single observation (FY2025: 26.2x at the FY2025 year-end price); FY2022-24 EBITDA was negative or trivial so no multiple exists. bear = 10yr min, base = 10yr avg, bull = 10yr max, all 26.2x by construction.
exit_multiple_cap.terminal_value_rule: terminal_value = max(0, min(Gordon(g, WACC), terminal_cap_multiple x year-10 owner FCF, exit_multiple_cap x year-10 EBITDA)). The engine applies the first two; the EV/EBITDA cap is recorded here and checked against valuation.*.implied_terminal_ev_to_ebitda (bear 2.4x, base 5.9x, bull 7.1x after the fix), so it is non-binding in every scenario and Gordon at 13% is the operative bound.
exit_multiple_cap.note: Because net cash is ~RMB2.5bn against a terminal EV of ~RMB2.8bn (base), the EV/EBITDA cap would have to be set at well under 10x to move the value; the historical range does not support that, so the cap is retained as a guard-rail rather than a value driver.

sanity_check.fix_applied: 2026-10-24 Step 8c.5 fix pass. Trip: implied P/B 3.13x (> 1.5x the 10yr max 2.02x) and EV/EBITDA 46.5x (> 1.5x the 10yr max 26.2x) at the pre-fix weighted IV of HKD 10.46; diagnosis wacc_too_low. Fix: WACC raised from 10.0% to 13.0% in all three scenarios by adding explicit structural premiums on top of the base 10% (small-cap illiquidity +1.5%, PRC regulatory single-point-of-failure +1.0%, concentrated geography +0.5%; see inputs.wacc_rationale), and an exit_multiple_cap block (26.2x EV/EBITDA per scenario, non-binding) added. No driver path, weight, anchor or terminal-growth assumption was changed. Weighted IV HKD 10.46 -> 8.55 (-18%); base 10.99 -> 8.95; bull 16.83 -> 12.81; bear 5.33 -> 5.05.
sanity_check.implied_multiples_after_fix: Measured at the post-fix weighted IV (HKD 8.55): P/B 2.55x (within 1.5x the 2.02x max), EV/EBITDA 37.2x (inside the 39.3x threshold; 46.5x pre-fix), P/S 0.30x, P/E 70.0x; passed = true, no trip reasons. The script's multiples remain structurally high for two reasons that are not valuation errors: (a) its EV uses the CSV CashAndEquivalents (RMB710m bank balances) whereas the model's net-cash bridge includes time deposits, redeemable wealth-management products and principal-protected notes (RMB2,628m in total, all listed in inputs.cash_composition) - on the model's own bridge the implied EV/EBITDA at the weighted IV is ~17x pre-fix and ~12x post-fix on FY2025 adjusted EBITDA of RMB221m after SBC; (b) the history is one year (FY2025) of positive EBITDA, so 'the 10yr range' is a single point at a depressed price. The judgment is that the 13% WACC is a defensible structural rate for a sub-HKD3bn PRC small-cap, not a number reverse-engineered to pass; the fix is kept even though most of the gap is a cash-definition mismatch in the check.

bridge.item: Anchor refresh (price, net cash, shares, FX): none - same day
Driver paths (growth, margin, SBC, tax, WC, terminal growth, weights): unchanged
WACC 10.0% -> 13.0% (structural premiums: illiquidity +1.5, regulatory +1.0, geography +0.5) in all scenarios
exit_multiple_cap added (26.2x EV/EBITDA): non-binding, Gordon still binds

scenario_narratives.base: YSB stays the largest independent outside-of-hospital B2B pharma platform, with ~460k active buyers and a 94% paying ratio, but the core two-sided marketplace has stopped growing and the business is now a thin-margin distributor whose profit growth comes from mix: own-brand and Targeted Product Launch SKUs lift Self-operation gross margin ~0.3pp a year, revenue grows mid-single digits (run-rate +4.5%) with bolt-on acquisitions, and the negative cash-conversion cycle keeps the business self-funding. Adjusted EBITDA margin reaches 2.2% by year 8 (owner FCF ~1.3% of revenue), cash tax ramps in from year 3 as the RMB1.3bn tax-loss stock expires, and the RMB2.5bn net cash (of which ~2.1bn is supplier float) is retained at full value on a going-concern basis.
scenario_narratives.bull: The pharmaceutical retail downturn that stalled buyer growth in 2025-26 ends; primary-care policy ('Healthy China 2030') and lower-tier penetration restart buyer growth at mid-single digits, private label compounds at 30%+ to a double-digit share of Self-operation, Jinfang TCM standards and SaaS/AI tools lift take-rates, on-demand retail becomes a second leg, and M&A on the Yikuai template adds scale. Adjusted EBITDA margin triples to 3% and revenue reaches ~RMB37bn by year 10; the buyback and dividend confirm cash is for shareholders.
scenario_narratives.bear: Saturation and competition: the registered pharmacy/clinic base is fully penetrated, SOE distributors and internet-health platforms subsidise B2B channels, the high-margin marketplace keeps shrinking (-13% H1 FY2026), and private-label margin gains are competed away. Revenue goes flat in FY2027 and declines in FY2028-29; the supplier float that produced FY2024-25's cash inflows reverses and owner FCF falls to near zero. Adjusted EBITDA settles at 1.1%, the terminal multiple is 12x, and equity value is essentially the residual cash - the scenario in which the market's below-net-cash price is the right one if the float is not fully shareholders'.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% default to 30%: active-buyer growth has gone from +18% to flat in 18 months, the highest-margin segment is shrinking in absolute terms, net margin is ~1% with no cushion, SOE/internet competitors have deeper pockets, and the equity trades below its own net cash - the market is pricing a bear-or-worse outcome (or doubting the cash), so the bear deserves real weight. Bull cut to 20% because it needs several independent things to go right (retail-market recovery, private-label mix continuing to compound, a new on-demand retail business, and margin expansion against better-capitalised rivals). Base 50%.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Owner-FCF DCF on a component build (revenue x adjusted-EBITDA margin, less SBC, lease cash and D&A ex-ROU, tax ramping from 0% to 20%, plus the supplier-float working-capital capture on revenue CHANGE), 10-year horizon because the margin is still maturing, 13% CNY WACC in all scenarios (10% base rate plus 3pp of documented structural premiums for illiquidity, PRC regulatory dependence and single-country exposure), with operating risk carried in the flows and the weights, terminal value = max(0, min(Gordon, 12-15x FCF)). Values computed in CNY and converted to the HKD quote at the dated CNY/HKD rate. The headline finding is that the market capitalisation is below net cash: the valuation therefore turns less on the growth path than on whether the RMB2.1bn supplier float inside net cash is genuinely shareholders' - it is on a going-concern basis, and the bear scenario models its unwind explicitly.
key_risks_to_valuation: Supplier float: ~RMB2.1bn of the RMB2.5bn net cash is payables-funded (payables 4.6bn vs inventories + receivables 2.5bn); a sustained revenue decline unwinds it, and bank-acceptance notes payable (2.15bn) exceed pledged deposits (1.24bn) by ~0.9bn that some would classify as debt (~HKD 1.5/share)
Buyer saturation: average monthly active buyers flat at ~460k in H1 FY2026 after +18% (FY2024) and +6.5% (FY2025); every scenario's growth now rests on wallet share and mix rather than buyer adds
Margin thinness: adjusted EBITDA ~1.5% of revenue, so a 0.1pp move in the margin path moves owner FCF by ~7-10%; the base case's rise to 2.2% depends on private-label mix continuing
Competition from SOE distributors (Jointown, Shanghai Pharmaceuticals) and JD Health / Alibaba Health B2B channels, which can subsidise commission rates and buyer acquisition

Cash tax: no tax has been paid to date; the model ramps to 20% by year 7 but the RMB1.3bn of unrecognised losses expiring 2026-28 could run off faster or slower than assumed, and HNTE status is renewed every three years

Governance/China small-cap discount: the ~70% share-price fall around the IPO lock-up expiry, continuing earn-out share issuance and PRC drug-distribution and lending regulation are reasons the market may not credit the cash at par; the DCF credits it fully

Discount rate: the 13% WACC embeds 3pp of structural premiums; at the unstacked 10% the weighted IV is HKD 10.46, so roughly a fifth of the value turns on whether the illiquidity/regulatory/geography premiums are the right way to price risks that the bear scenario and the 30% bear weight already partly carry (a possible double charge, deliberately accepted on the conservative side)
valuation_philosophy.sanity_check_fix: MULTIPLES SANITY CHECK TRIPPED AND FIXED (2026-10-24). At the first build (10% WACC) the weighted intrinsic value of HKD 10.46 implied P/B 3.13x and EV/EBITDA 46.5x against 10-year maxima of 2.02x and 26.2x, and the check diagnosed the WACC as too low for the structural risks in the qualitative analysis. What changed: the discount rate was raised from 10% to 13% in every scenario by adding explicit premiums on top of the base cost of equity - small-cap illiquidity +1.5% (HKD ~2.5bn market cap, 70% drawdown since the lock-up expiry), PRC regulatory single-point-of-failure +1.0% (GSP/online drug-sale licences through a VIE, HNTE status, lending rules), concentrated geography +0.5% (100% PRC) - and an exit-multiple cap of 26.2x EV/EBITDA (the one-year historical range) was added per scenario; it does not bind because the implied terminal EV/EBITDA is 2-7x. The scenario growth, margin, SBC, tax, working-capital and terminal-growth paths, the 30/50/20 weights and every balance-sheet anchor are unchanged. Effect: base HKD 10.99 -> 8.95, bull 16.83 -> 12.81, bear 5.33 -> 5.05, weighted 10.46 -> 8.55; the current price (inputs.price_as_of) remains below net cash of ~HKD 4.21 per share, so the 'below net cash' finding survives the fix. Caveat on the check itself: the script measures EV with the CSV's bank balances (RMB710m) rather than the model's full net-cash bridge (RMB2,628m including time deposits, redeemable wealth-management products and principal-protected notes), and its 'ten-year range' is a single FY2025 observation; on the model's own bridge the implied EV/EBITDA at the weighted IV is ~12x. The higher WACC is kept because it is a defensible rate for this security in its own right, not because the check demands it.
